perspective_summary: The unverified scientific hypothesis is H_state: conditional on the same signed scribble, cue geometry, non-state inputs, patient split, and training procedure, the frozen patient-excluded M0 state contains additional information about target, scope, and therefore the six-way legal joint. The strongest alternative is H_cue: signed polarity, geometry, non-M0 context, and generator regularities are sufficient, so full and no_M0 have equivalent patient-level generalization apart from sampling variation. A curriculum must be a neutral test harness for this contrast: use the same patient-first, legal-joint-balanced, simple-to-ambiguous schedule and exact minibatch order in both P2T arms, never rank examples with M0, residual-derived quantities, held-out outcomes, or model loss. This is a design-only proposal and asserts no training result, effect size, or six-class feasibility.

observations.statement: Every curriculum stage must retain PETCT-INTENT-v2.0 with operation={ADD,REMOVE}, target={SAME,NEW}, and scope={LOCAL,COMPLETE}, restricted to ADD_SAME_LOCAL, REMOVE_SAME_LOCAL, ADD_SAME_COMPLETE, REMOVE_SAME_COMPLETE, ADD_NEW_COMPLETE, and REMOVE_NEW_COMPLETE. ADD_NEW_LOCAL and REMOVE_NEW_LOCAL are structurally illegal and must never be generated, sampled, used as padding classes, or included in a normalization denominator.

H_state predicts that, after controlling the sampler and all non-M0 inputs, full may add conditional information chiefly for target, scope, and legal-joint prediction; an operation-only difference is not distinguishing because FN-derived positive cues and FP-derived negative cues already expose ADD versus REMOVE. This direction remains UNVERIFIED.

H_cue predicts that cue polarity, cue geometry, non-M0 image/context inputs, or generator shortcuts suffice, so matched full and no_M0 remain equivalent at patient level. A staged curriculum could also amplify those shortcuts rather than teach state-relative interpretation; flat sampling may therefore be equal or superior. Both alternatives remain UNVERIFIED.

The P2T primary remains full versus no_M0. Both arms must consume identical episode IDs, patient selections, sampling weights, stage boundaries, minibatch order, augmentation decisions, optimizer steps, training budget, and stopping rules. The only registered difference is access to M0-derived state paths in full; curriculum may not become an indirect M0 channel for no_M0.

Difficulty may use only training-partition, pre-model, arm-common descriptors frozen before fitting: controlled versus natural episode source, signed-cue geometry family, and cue-only morphology such as trace length, component count, and tortuosity. It must not use M0 values or derivatives, ground-truth residual magnitude or topology, post-edit state, patient or case identity tokens, held-out labels, final-test performance, per-example model loss, confidence, gradients, or result-adaptive mining.

Sampling must be patient-first so patients with many generated episodes do not dominate. Within a frozen scheduling window, balance the six legal joints, then balance geometry family and cue-only difficulty bins inside each joint as support permits. Preserve predeclared controlled/natural proportions, cap repeated exposure from one patient, and log every relaxation. Oversampling may rebalance eligible training episodes but may not fabricate missing patient support or justify feasibility.

Simple-first means increasing cue-only representational complexity, not declaring an intent class easy. All six legal joints remain eligible from the first fitted stage. Start with audited controlled episodes in lower cue-morphology complexity bins, then admit broader morphology and geometry, then cue-ambiguous and natural episodes, and finally consolidate on the complete locked training distribution. This prevents a stage boundary from serving as a target or scope label.

Stage transitions must be frozen as shared exposure or optimizer-update milestones before outcomes are inspected; they may not trigger separately from full or no_M0 validation performance. Training-only validation curves may diagnose instability but cannot change one arm's schedule, extend one arm's budget, or select hard examples. If a prespecified safety condition fires, pause both arms and repair the affected downstream stage under a newly versioned, prospectively frozen schedule.

No curriculum can be frozen until the downstream FN/FP atlas and patient-level episode audit establish preregistered usable support for every legal joint and show that target or scope is not deterministically exposed by cue geometry or administrative metadata. Sparse coverage is a stop condition, not permission to merge labels, synthesize NEW_LOCAL, or repeatedly sample a few patients.

The first operational blocker is exact downstream deployed-bundle and F0 closure after the stale-bundle failure. The committed patient-excluded OOF M0 set is a frozen upstream input and must not be rerun. Curriculum construction begins only after downstream closure, M0 evaluation, atlas construction, signed episode generation, and coverage/leakage audits succeed.

The current canonical remains the simple 17-channel state/cue P2T model with state/cue-support pooling, a geometry MLP, and joint/operation/target/scope heads. Cross-attention belongs only in a separately authorized deferred future ablation after the simple-primary full-versus-no_M0 study; it cannot define a curriculum stage, replace full, or rescue a falsified primary.

No v2 six-class P2T training, inference, metric, effect estimate, external-comparator result, or publication-level conclusion currently exists. Proposed stage order, balance rules, and expected learning behavior are UNVERIFIED design choices, not evidence that the curriculum or state-conditioned mechanism works.

proposed_mechanisms.description: A fixed, patient-first curriculum for the canonical simple P2T interface. It teaches coverage before complexity while keeping all six legal joints present and keeps curriculum identical between full and no_M0 so the primary contrast still isolates access to M0 state.
inputs: Versioned patient-disjoint training episode manifest after downstream bundle/F0 and atlas gates
Six legal PETCT-INTENT-v2.0 joint labels used only for supervised balance
Arm-common signed scribble, geometry family, and frozen cue-only morphology descriptors
Controlled/natural episode-source flag and a preregistered patient-first sampling policy
Canonical simple 17-channel P2T full and no_M0 arm definitions
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: Gate C0 performs no fitting: close bundle/F0, bind each case to its committed OOF M0, audit patient exclusivity, prove absence of both NEW_LOCAL joints, establish usable patient support for all six legal joints, and freeze the episode and sampler manifests. Stage C1 draws patients first, then legal joints, using audited controlled episodes from lower cue-only morphology bins while retaining every legal joint and balancing geometry within support. Stage C2 progressively admits higher cue-only morphology bins and broader geometry under the same patient/joint quotas. Stage C3 introduces cue-ambiguous and natural episodes, where ambiguity strata are frozen from training-only signed-cue and geometry descriptors plus supervised labels, never from M0 or model behavior. Stage C4 removes the staged emphasis and consolidates on the complete locked training distribution. Transitions occur at preregistered shared exposure milestones. Full and no_M0 replay the exact same episode order, augmentations, optimizer steps, and budget; the output remains the frozen six-way joint plus operation, target, and scope heads.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: If the curriculum supports optimization without creating shortcuts, training-only diagnostics should show stable learning across legal joints as complexity is admitted, and the locked primary comparison should remain interpretable as full versus no_M0. Under H_state, any distinguishing held-out signal should appear principally in patient-level target, scope, and legal-joint contrasts on identical episodes; operation-only separation is insufficient. These directions are UNVERIFIED and no numerical gain is asserted.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: The mechanism fails as a valid test harness if a stage omits a legal joint, repeated episodes from a few patients substitute for patient coverage, stage or difficulty metadata reveals target/scope, cue geometry deterministically predicts labels, any M0/residual/held-out/model-loss quantity influences ordering, the two arms receive different schedules or budgets, or the final stage never returns to the complete locked training distribution. Any such failure invalidates interpretation and triggers a paired stop or rollback rather than result-adaptive mining.

proposed_mechanisms.description: A preregistered hard-example ordering that separates representational complexity from empirical error. Hard examples are defined before fitting from arm-common cue descriptors, not discovered from model failures, so the schedule cannot optimize against held-out outcomes or leak M0 into no_M0.
inputs: Training-only cue trace length, component count, and tortuosity bins
Training-only cue-descriptor neighborhoods used to flag target/scope ambiguity
Frozen legal-joint and patient balance constraints
proposed_mechanisms.transformation: Freeze an ordinal stratum key before model initialization: audited controlled before natural, lower before higher cue-only morphological complexity, and cue-distinct before cue-ambiguous neighborhoods. Apply that order only inside patient-first and legal-joint-balanced windows, so difficulty never changes class coverage. Do not recompute strata after training begins. Loss, confidence, gradient norm, checkpoint predictions, final-test labels, M0 overlap, residual topology, and post-edit outcomes are prohibited hardness signals. Log the manifest hash and every support-driven relaxation for both arms.
proposed_mechanisms.expected_signal: The curriculum-specific, UNVERIFIED expectation is reduced early collapse onto polarity or majority joints and smoother acquisition of target/scope discrimination compared with a budget-matched flat sampler on development data. The strongest alternative is that flat sampling is equivalent or better, or that staged ordering magnifies cue shortcuts; only the separately registered curriculum ablation can distinguish these.
proposed_mechanisms.failure_mode: If cue-only bins are themselves deterministic label proxies, if balance requires unsupported patients, if strata change after observing model behavior, or if full and no_M0 receive different orders, the hardness mechanism is confounded. Stop both arms; do not compensate with longer training, label merging, an OOF rerun, or cross-attention.

experiments.comparison: Run the frozen first-paper P2T primary, full versus no_M0, with the canonical simple 17-channel interface and the exact same frozen simple-first curriculum. Full receives declared M0-derived state paths; no_M0 neutralizes only those paths. Polarity-blind and geometry-only remain diagnostics, and cross-attention is absent from the current primary matrix.
held_constant: Patient-disjoint split and committed patient-excluded OOF M0 provenance, without an OOF rerun
Episode IDs, legal labels, signed scribbles, controlled/natural membership, and patient-first sampling weights
Difficulty strata, stage transitions, minibatch order, augmentations, and total example exposure
Simple 17-channel backbone, state/cue-support pooling, geometry MLP, and joint/operation/target/scope heads
Initialization policy, optimizer, scheduler, regularization, checkpoint rule, early-stopping rule, and total training budget
Patient-level metrics, resampling unit, leakage checks, and falsification rule
experiments.observable: Use the preregistered patient-level paired joint loss or joint metric, with secondary target and scope contrasts and operation reported as a polarity-shortcut diagnostic. Report per-legal-joint patient support and controlled, natural, cue-simple, and cue-ambiguous slices without promoting a slice to a new primary. Required integrity evidence includes identical sampler and episode hashes across arms, no patient overlap, correct case-to-OOF-M0 binding, no forbidden M0-derived sampler path in no_M0, and no ground-truth residual, post-edit, identity, or administrative feature reaching inference.
experiments.falsifier: After bundle/F0, coverage, sampler-parity, and leakage gates pass, falsify H_state for this interface under the prespecified patient-level directional rule if full does not improve the locked primary joint estimand and neither target nor scope supplies the predicted direction. Treat uncertainty as inconclusive and accepted equivalence as support for H_cue. Do not rescue a falsified or inconclusive result by changing curriculum, extending one arm, rerunning OOF M0, or introducing cross-attention.

experiments.comparison: In a separately registered development-only audit that does not alter or replace the frozen held-out first-paper matrix, compare the preregistered staged sampler with a flat sampler over the same eligible training episodes. Use the same canonical simple architecture and evaluate only on the patient-disjoint development partition. Any proposal to expose this ablation to the locked test set requires separate authorization and prospective registration.
held_constant: Training and development patients and episode manifest
Total per-patient and per-legal-joint exposure over the full run
Controlled/natural episode inventory and all six legal joints
Architecture, inputs, augmentation policy, initialization seeds, optimizer, scheduler, checkpoint rule, and training budget
Development metric definitions and patient-level aggregation
No held-out test access and no result-adaptive stage changes
experiments.observable: Compare patient-level development joint, target, and scope behavior; legal-joint collapse indicators; calibration; and training stability under staged versus flat ordering. Inspect whether any apparent advantage is confined to operation or cue-determined strata. This audit tests the curriculum itself and produces no publication-level claim without a separately authorized analysis.
experiments.falsifier: Reject the curriculum-specific expectation if the flat sampler is equivalent or superior under the prospectively frozen development rule, if the staged sampler harms any supported legal joint beyond its preregistered tolerance, or if its apparent benefit is confined to polarity-driven operation. In that case retain the frozen primary matrix and choose the simpler nonadaptive schedule prospectively; do not inspect the locked test set to decide.

experiments.comparison: Before fitting either arm, audit the proposed staged and flat manifests against the same frozen downstream episode pool: patient exclusivity, six-joint support, absence of NEW_LOCAL, geometry and cue-morphology balance, controlled/natural composition, stage-to-label predictability, M0-path exclusion from sampler fields, and exact arm replay parity.
held_constant: Frozen committed OOF M0 inputs without rerun
Versioned downstream bundle/F0 and episode-generation contract
Patient as the sampling and analysis unit
Six legal joints and three factor heads
Predeclared support, leakage, balance-relaxation, and stop rules
experiments.observable: Produce a manifest-level audit rather than a model result: patient counts and episode support by legal joint and stage; duplicate and cross-split hashes; label cross-tabs against stage, geometry, and cue-only bins; a prohibited-field inventory; case-to-M0 bindings; and exact episode-order hashes for full and no_M0. Any values are evidence inputs to the gate, not scientific outcomes.
experiments.falsifier: Do not train if any legal joint lacks preregistered patient support, either NEW_LOCAL joint appears, any patient or derivative crosses partitions, stage or metadata deterministically exposes target/scope, a prohibited M0/residual/outcome field affects sampling, case-to-M0 binding fails, or arm replay hashes differ. Repair only the affected downstream bundle, episode, or sampler stage; none of these failures authorizes rerunning OOF M0.

blockers: FIRST OPERATIONAL BLOCKER: close, hash, and verify the exact downstream deployed software bundle and F0 contract after the stale-bundle failure. Do not begin M0 evaluation, atlas construction, episode generation, curriculum fitting, or P2T training until closure passes; do not rerun the already committed OOF M0 set.

COVERAGE STOP: after downstream closure, halt before fitting unless the FN/FP atlas and patient-level episode audit meet prospectively frozen support criteria for all six legal joints. Never manufacture support through repeated episodes, label merging, or either illegal NEW_LOCAL joint.

SAMPLER-LEAKAGE STOP: halt if M0 or an M0 derivative, ground-truth residual information, post-edit state, patient/case identifiers, held-out outcomes, administrative artifacts, or model-derived difficulty affects hardness, sampling, or transitions. Curriculum metadata must not become an indirect state or label channel.

ARM-PARITY STOP AND ROLLBACK: if full and no_M0 differ in episode order, stage exposure, augmentation, optimizer steps, budget, stopping, or any path beyond the registered M0 neutralization, stop both arms, invalidate the affected downstream run, restore the last common pre-stage checkpoint, and rerun only after a newly versioned prospective manifest passes parity checks.

OPTIMIZATION STOP: if a preregistered training-only safety check detects nonfinite optimization, supported-joint collapse, or a balance relaxation beyond tolerance, pause both primary arms together. Do not mine held-out errors, extend one arm, or tune stage boundaries after outcome access.

CURRICULUM DECISION BOUNDARY: staged-versus-flat sampling is a separately registered development audit, not a replacement primary contrast. The first-paper scientific primary remains P2T full versus no_M0 under one shared frozen schedule.
ARCHITECTURE BOUNDARY: cross-attention is deferred future ablation only, after the canonical simple-primary study. It cannot be the current primary, a curriculum stage, or a post hoc rescue.
